items.title: File Widerspruch against the Kontenklärung decision
items.quote: Ein Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid ist binnen eines Monats nach dessen Bekanntgabe zulässig.
items.computation: Letter is dated 27.11.2025 and no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' is given, so the posting date is 27.11.2025. This is a social-law body (Rentenversicherungsträger, § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X), so the 4-day delivery fiction applies and, unlike tax offices, the delivery day is NOT shifted even if it falls on a weekend/holiday. Counting 4 calendar days after 27.11.2025 (not counting the posting day itself): 28.11, 29.11, 30.11, 01.12.2025 → deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe) = 01.12.2025 (a Monday, so no adjustment needed anyway). The one-month Widerspruch period runs from the day after delivery and ends, per §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB / § 26 SGB X, on the day one month later bearing the same number as the delivery day: 01.01.2026. That day is New Year's Day, a nationwide public holiday, so under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X the deadline moves to the next working day. 01.01.2026 is a Thursday, so the next working day is Friday 02.01.2026.

warnings: The letterhead explicitly labels the sender 'Gesetzliche Rentenversicherung (fiktiv)' and uses template placeholders (Musterstadt, Musterstraße-style address, fictional PLZ), indicating this is a sample/template document rather than a genuine authority letter — verify authenticity before acting on it.

Given that today's actual date is 2026-09-25, the computed Widerspruch deadline of 02.01.2026 has almost certainly already passed; if this is a real, current letter the dates should be re-checked against the actual posting date.

The Land used for the holiday adjustment (NRW, the recipient's Land) was assumed because the letterhead's location ('Musterstadt') is fictional and does not indicate a real German Land; if the real Rentenversicherung office sits elsewhere the deadline could differ (though New Year's Day is a nationwide holiday, so this particular result would not change).
